title: Writing the eulogy for one of the 'Invisibles'

tellings.quote: during the time that I knew Tyler uh there were other people like him Invisibles like I called them the Invisibles right and one of them had passed away and this is a person whose family didn't even know what they did

plain: There are people working on secret projects so hidden that even their own families do not know what they do, and when one of them died, Diana Pasulka, a scholar of religion who studies belief in UFOs, wrote his eulogy. Pasulka tells Michels this herself, saying that while she knew a man she calls Tyler she met others like him, whom she named the Invisibles. Her story is a glimpse of how lives inside such work stay unseen even in death.
